Review of [Lulu and Georgia](https://www.trustpilot.com/review/www.luluandgeorgia.com)

* * *

## [The quality is poor and the photos…](https://www.trustpilot.com/reviews/6a5a6d327e1be49a9353fd9a)
Definitely not worth the price. The quality is poor and the photos online misrepresent the coffee table purchased. When shopping online I study the photos and take the narrative seriously as I am aware of the nightmare of returning a large item. But when the photos aren't reliable, not much you can do.Trying to return through this company is difficult and obfuscated, chat and email only. Keep in mind that you will be charged a service fee to "restock" as well as a return shipping. Buyer beware.

July 15, 2026

* * *

Reply from Lulu and Georgia

Jul 20, 2026

Hi Adrienne,

Thank you for sharing your feedback. We are sincerely sorry to hear of your disappointment with your purchase and that the item did not align with your expectations.

We apologize for any difficulty or frustration you've experienced with our support channels and return guidelines. If you are still working through this process, please reach out to us at support@luluandgeorgia.com so our team can ensure your inquiry is handled properly.
